bio: This restaurant in the eponymous hotel in the old town serves modern dishes that draw on international influences as well as Austrian classics. You can dine à la carte or opt for a set menu (vegetarian option). Be sure to peruse the decent wine list with an emphasis on Austrian labels. A striking white vaulted ceiling, lovely parquet flooring and delightful nods to tradition in the decor contribute to the atmosphere. Parking at Altstadtgarage A....
